marrakech.title: Marrakech
marrakech.description: Marrakech is one of Morocco’s historic imperial cities, known for its medina, colorful souks, Jemaa el-Fnaa square, traditional riads and gardens.

fes.title: Fes
fes.description: Fes is one of Morocco’s oldest imperial cities, famous for its historic medina, traditional crafts, ancient madrasas, narrow streets and rich cultural heritage.

casablanca.title: Casablanca
casablanca.description: Casablanca is Morocco’s largest city and an important economic center, known for the Hassan II Mosque, Atlantic coastline, modern neighborhoods and international connections.

tangier.title: Tangier
tangier.description: Tangier is a historic port city in northern Morocco overlooking the Strait of Gibraltar, known for its medina, coastal views, international history and easy access to northern Morocco.

rabat.title: Rabat
rabat.description: Rabat is the capital of Morocco and one of the country’s imperial cities, known for the Hassan Tower, Kasbah of the Udayas, royal landmarks and Atlantic coastline.

chefchaouen.title: Chefchaouen
chefchaouen.description: Chefchaouen is a mountain town in northern Morocco famous for its blue-painted medina, relaxed atmosphere, traditional streets and Rif Mountain surroundings.

ouarzazate.title: Ouarzazate
ouarzazate.description: Ouarzazate is a city in southern Morocco known for historic kasbahs, film studios and its position between the High Atlas Mountains and the Sahara routes.

essaouira.title: Essaouira
essaouira.description: Essaouira is a relaxed Atlantic coastal city known for its historic medina, fishing port, beaches, traditional architecture and strong artistic atmosphere.

agadir.title: Agadir
agadir.description: Agadir is a modern coastal city in southern Morocco known for its long beach, marina, seaside resorts, pleasant climate and access to the Souss region.

meknes.title: Meknes
meknes.description: Meknes is one of Morocco’s imperial cities, known for monumental gates, historic architecture, traditional markets and its location close to Volubilis.

ifrane.title: Ifrane
ifrane.description: Ifrane is a mountain town in the Middle Atlas known for clean streets, alpine-style architecture, forests and cooler temperatures.

midelt.title: Midelt
midelt.description: Midelt is a town between the Middle Atlas and High Atlas Mountains and is a common stop on routes connecting Fes with Merzouga and the Sahara.

erfoud.title: Erfoud
erfoud.description: Erfoud is a desert gateway town in southeastern Morocco known for fossils, date palms and its location close to Rissani and the Merzouga dunes.

rissani.title: Rissani
rissani.description: Rissani is a historic town near Merzouga known for its traditional market, desert culture, regional trade and important place in the history of southeastern Morocco.

merzouga.title: Merzouga
merzouga.description: Merzouga is a desert village in southeastern Morocco beside the Erg Chebbi dunes, known for camel trekking, Sahara camps, sunsets and sunrise experiences.

erg-chebbi.title: Erg Chebbi
erg-chebbi.description: Erg Chebbi is the famous golden Sahara dune field beside Merzouga, known for camel trekking, desert camps, sunset and sunrise experiences.

ait-ben-haddou.title: Ait Ben Haddou
ait-ben-haddou.description: Ait Ben Haddou is a historic fortified settlement in southern Morocco. The Ksar of Ait-Ben-Haddou is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

dades-valley.title: Dades Valley
dades-valley.description: Dades Valley is a scenic region in southern Morocco known for traditional villages, kasbahs, dramatic rock formations and mountain landscapes.

todra-gorge.title: Todra Gorge
todra-gorge.description: Todra Gorge is a dramatic canyon in southern Morocco known for its high limestone walls and scenic walking area.

tinghir.title: Tinghir
tinghir.description: Tinghir is an oasis town in southern Morocco surrounded by palm groves and rocky landscapes and is the main gateway to Todra Gorge.

high-atlas-mountains.title: High Atlas Mountains
high-atlas-mountains.description: The High Atlas Mountains form Morocco’s largest mountain range and create a spectacular route between Marrakech and southern Morocco.

tizi-ntichka.title: Tizi n'Tichka Pass
tizi-ntichka.description: Tizi n'Tichka is a high mountain pass on the road between Marrakech and Ouarzazate, known for winding roads and panoramic High Atlas views.

skoura.title: Skoura
skoura.description: Skoura is a peaceful oasis in southern Morocco known for palm groves, traditional kasbahs and its location between Ouarzazate and the Dades Valley.

rose-valley.title: Rose Valley
rose-valley.description: Rose Valley is a scenic area near Kelaat M'Gouna known for rose cultivation, traditional villages, valley landscapes and Morocco’s annual rose season.

kelaat-mgouna.title: Kelaat M'Gouna
kelaat-mgouna.description: Kelaat M'Gouna is a town in southern Morocco known as a gateway to the Rose Valley and for its annual rose festival and local rose products.

zagora.title: Zagora
zagora.description: Zagora is a desert town in the Draa Valley and a popular starting point for shorter desert journeys, palm-oasis landscapes and southern Morocco adventures.

draa-valley.title: Draa Valley
draa-valley.description: Draa Valley is one of southern Morocco’s most famous oasis regions, known for palm groves, traditional villages, kasbahs and desert landscapes.

khamlia.title: Khamlia
khamlia.description: Khamlia is a village near Merzouga known for its connection with Gnawa musical traditions and the cultural heritage of southeastern Morocco.

asilah.title: Asilah
asilah.description: Asilah is a small Atlantic coastal town in northern Morocco known for its whitewashed medina, colorful murals, seaside atmosphere and historic walls.

tetouan.title: Tetouan
tetouan.description: Tetouan is a historic northern Moroccan city known for its medina, Andalusian influence, traditional architecture and proximity to the Mediterranean coast.

taroudant.title: Taroudant
taroudant.description: Taroudant is a historic walled city in the Souss Valley known for traditional markets, red city walls and a quieter atmosphere than Marrakech.

ourika-valley.title: Ourika Valley
ourika-valley.description: Ourika Valley is a popular mountain escape near Marrakech known for rivers, traditional villages, mountain scenery and access to the High Atlas.

volubilis.title: Volubilis
volubilis.description: Volubilis is an important archaeological site near Meknes known for Roman ruins, mosaics, columns and its UNESCO World Heritage status.

imlil.title: Imlil
imlil.description: Imlil is a mountain village in Morocco’s High Atlas Mountains, known as a popular base for hiking, traditional Berber villages, scenic valleys and routes toward Mount Toubkal.

agdez.title: Agdez
agdez.description: Agdez is a small town at the northern entrance of the Draa Valley, known for palm groves, traditional kasbahs, mountain scenery and its location on the route between Ouarzazate and Zagora.

tamegroute.title: Tamegroute
tamegroute.description: Tamegroute is a historic village near Zagora in southern Morocco, known for its old religious library, traditional green pottery, desert culture and location along the Draa Valley route.

ouzoud-waterfalls.title: Ouzoud Waterfalls
ouzoud-waterfalls.description: Ouzoud Waterfalls are among Morocco’s best-known natural attractions, famous for high cascades, green valley scenery, walking paths, viewpoints and a peaceful countryside setting.

ziz-valley.title: Ziz Valley
ziz-valley.description: Ziz Valley is a long oasis valley in southeastern Morocco known for palm groves, dramatic viewpoints, traditional settlements and its position on routes toward Erfoud and Merzouga.

kasbah-tadla.title: Kasbah Tadla
kasbah-tadla.description: Kasbah Tadla is a historic town in central Morocco on the route between the Middle Atlas region and the Atlantic side of the country, known for its regional history and surrounding agricultural landscapes.

imilchil.title: Imilchil
imilchil.description: Imilchil is a mountain town in Morocco’s High Atlas known for traditional villages, remote valleys, cooler mountain landscapes and its strong Amazigh cultural heritage.

errachidia.title: Errachidia
errachidia.description: Errachidia is a city in southeastern Morocco and an important gateway to the Ziz Valley, Tafilalet region and routes toward Erfoud and Merzouga.

ait-atta-villages.title: Ait Atta Villages
ait-atta-villages.description: Ait Atta villages in southeastern Morocco are connected with Amazigh cultural heritage and are found across rural mountain and valley landscapes around the wider Dades and Jbel Saghro regions.

demnate.title: Demnate
demnate.description: Demnate is a historic town east of Marrakech near the Atlas foothills, known for surrounding Amazigh villages, mountain landscapes and geological attractions in the wider region.

middle-atlas.title: Middle Atlas Mountains
middle-atlas.description: The Middle Atlas is a mountain region in central Morocco known for cedar forests, high plateaus, mountain towns, rural communities and scenic roads between Fes and southeastern Morocco.

azrou.title: Azrou
azrou.description: Azrou is a small town in the Middle Atlas region of Morocco, known for its traditional architecture and scenic mountain views.
